title: Scrub through one latent diffusion sample
description: Move the checkpoint from prompt encoding to decoded pixels, then compare how a U-Net and a diffusion transformer represent the denoising work.

backbones.label: U-Net denoiser
backbones.detail: Processes multi-scale feature maps with skip connections and text conditioning.
backbones.lesson: The U-Net changes the latent at every noise level; skip connections preserve information across spatial scales.

backbones.label: Diffusion transformer
backbones.detail: Patchifies the latent and mixes spatial tokens with timestep and conditioning information.
backbones.lesson: The transformer is the denoiser inside the diffusion loop, not necessarily a token-by-token pixel decoder.

phases.label: Encode text
phases.description: Tokenize the prompt and produce contextual vectors for subjects, attributes, and relationships.

phases.label: Sample noise
phases.description: Create the initial latent state. The seed chooses one starting point, not a quality level.

phases.label: Form composition
phases.description: Early and middle updates establish large shapes, placement, and broad color regions.

phases.label: Refine detail
phases.description: Later updates refine boundaries and texture; they cannot reliably repair a missing composition.

phases.label: Decode pixels
phases.description: Convert the final latent to pixels. The result still needs quality and safety evaluation.
